keyPoints: Autocomplete is browser-side (Google Maps JS SDK) — 300ms debounce, no backend request until search is submitted; the API's own GET /autocomplete route is currently unused by the frontend
Cache key includes the calendar date, so entries reset at UTC midnight rather than N hours after being written — "24h TTL" understates this
Weather fetch spans today through the coming Saturday/Sunday, not just the weekend
Result filtering uses fixed thresholds: quality score ≥ 7, and the response is trimmed to 5-15 trails
Identical structured JSON logging middleware to momentum-finder — same KQL queries work for both
Scales to zero when idle — same cold start caveat as momentum-finder
Google Places and Custom Search quotas are the primary cost driver; OpenAI is secondary
architecture.overview: FastAPI app with a sequential pipeline of external API calls fanned out where possible. Azure OpenAI synthesizes the final output from all gathered context. The in-memory cache is a Python dict keyed by f"{city}:{date}" — cleared on container restart, and its date component means an entry effectively expires at UTC midnight rather than N hours after it was written.

description: FastAPI Container App that generates personalised trail recommendations for a given city. Fans out across Google Places, weather, and search APIs, then synthesizes a condition summary and gear list with Azure OpenAI. Results are cached per city+date until the next UTC day.
features: City search with Google Maps JS SDK autocomplete — runs entirely in the browser, zero backend cost (a server-side GET /autocomplete route also exists in the API but is not called by the current frontend)
Geocodes the city and searches Google Places for nearby hiking trails
Fetches weather from Open-Meteo for today through the coming weekend (free, no API key)
Pulls AllTrails snippets via Google Custom Search for additional trail context
Azure OpenAI synthesizes a condition summary and gear list from all sources
Filters/ranks results using fixed thresholds (quality score ≥ 7, 5-15 results returned)
In-memory result cache keyed by normalised city name + date — resets at UTC midnight, not a rolling 24h window
role: Trail recommendations + conditions via Google Places & AI
summary: Given a city, geocodes it, searches Google Places for nearby trails, fetches weather from Open-Meteo for today through the coming weekend, pulls AllTrails snippets via Google Custom Search, then synthesizes a condition summary and gear list with Azure OpenAI. Results are cached in memory, keyed by city + date, until the next UTC day. Runs as a Container App with the same logging middleware as momentum-finder.
title: trail-finder
